text: おばちゃん　あなたの　たたかい　かたに　ほれちゃったわー！

structure.jp: あなたの　たたかい　かたに

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the short spoken form of てしまった, which says the thing happened completely, beyond your control. ほれちゃった = 'I've gone and fallen for it'

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた after the stem of a verb means 'the way of doing' it. たたかい　かた = 'the way you battle'

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way to add feeling to what you say. ほれちゃったわー = 'oh, I've fallen for it!'
